Bundled brush fonts (unmodified upstream TTF files)
Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl

Ma Shan Zheng: ofl/mashanzheng/MaShanZheng-Regular.ttf
Zhi Mang Xing: ofl/zhimangxing/ZhiMangXing-Regular.ttf

Downloaded 2026-10-26. Fonts are self-hosted; no runtime request to Google Fonts is required.
